title: Unique normalized derived descent of a scalar pullback chain map
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E,L of Q_ell, an embedding iota:E to L, schemes X,Y and a scheme morphism g:X to Y. Use the actual ordinary and derived scalar functors and their canonical counits from [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], and the normalized pullback comparisons from [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Suppose ordinary scalar extension on Y sends good complexes to good complexes and its universal derived counit is invertible on every complex over Y. Then every natural chain transformation from A_E followed by scalar extension on X to scalar extension on Y followed by A_L descends to a unique natural transformation Lg_E followed by derived scalar extension on X to derived scalar extension on Y followed by Lg_L satisfying the exact equation [def-sf-scalar-pullback-strict-cone-data]. No invertibility of the chain transformation and no K-flatness of A_E(P) are assumed.

proof.text: Lift scalar extension on good E-complexes to good L-complexes using the good-preservation hypothesis. Its canonical derived scalar counit on Y is invertible by hypothesis and natural, so its components form eta: q_E followed by derived scalar extension is isomorphic to the lifted good scalar functor followed by q_L. Use the existing good-complex localization theorem to regard q_E as a localization at the restricted quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: On good representatives compose the normalized E-pullback comparison, the X scalar counit and the localization of the supplied chain map to form a. Compose eta with the L-pullback comparison to form an isomorphism b from the restricted target derived functor. Insert explicit functor associators and the lift/inclusion comparison so that the functor expressions have the stated parentheses.

proof.text: Apply the proved localization_descent_with_comparison helper, which uses fully faithful precomposition along q_E, to a and b. It gives a unique tau with tau(q_E P) followed by b(P) equal to a(P).

proof.text: Compute the components of a and b. Every inserted associator has identity components; normalize the canonical scalar counits using their model-counit equalities. The resulting equation is exactly ScalarPullbackDescentFormula. Proof irrelevance identifies any supplied good-complex proof with the chosen lift proof. Conversely every transformation satisfying that displayed equation satisfies the localization helper equation, so the same uniqueness applies.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullbackDescent_existsUnique
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (good : ∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
      integralOperationsGoodComplex l L Y
        ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι Y).obj P.obj))
    (counit : ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ,
      IsIso (completedScalarCounit l E L ι Y P))
    (δ : integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E g ⋙
        completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X ⟶
      completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι Y ⋙
        integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l L g) :
    ∃! τ : integralDerivedPullback l E g ⋙ completedDerivedScalarExtension l E L ι X ⟶
        completedDerivedScalarExtension l E L ι Y ⋙ integralDerivedPullback l L g,
      ScalarPullbackDescentFormula l E L ι g δ τ
